PHCollection.doc: The abstract superclass for Photos asset collections and collection lists.

PHCollectionList.doc: A group containing Photos asset collections, such as Moments, Years, or folders of user-created albums.

PHAssetCollectionSubtypeSmartAlbumRecent.doc: A Smart Album that groups all recently added assets in the photo library.

PHAssetCollectionSubtypeSmartAlbumSelfPo.doc: A Smart Album that groups all photos and videos captured using the device’s front-facing camera.

PHAssetCollectionSubtypeSmartAlbumSlomoV.doc: A Smart Album that groups all Slow-Mo videos in the photo library.
